description: Header file defining the internal implementation of a raw hash map class template within the Abseil C++ library, including methods for insertion, assignment, and element access.

classes.name: raw_hash_map
classes.description: Template class implementing a hash map based on raw hash set, supporting insertion, assignment, and element access.

methods.name: insert_or_assign
methods.description: Inserts or assigns a value for a given key, supporting various argument types and overloads.

methods.name: try_emplace
methods.description: Attempts to construct an element in-place with provided arguments if the key does not exist.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Provides access to the mapped value associated with a key, throwing if the key is not found.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses or inserts a value for a given key, returning a reference to the mapped value.
